messages:
Maya Chen: Quick summary — got a strong pulse from Acme trial yesterday. Two asks: 1) per-tenant KV/cache for conversation context (they say >30% fewer tokens & much better latency), 2) tenant SSO which we had planned for v1. They also called out some UI polish but said that can wait.

Leo Park: thanks — can you paste the ask and any logs? how severe is the latency regression vs baseline?

Maya Chen: attaching their notes in thread. They reported tail latency spikes around 800ms for interactive flows vs our target 200-300ms. They tie part of it to repeated prefix tokens across calls.

Rachel G: cc @Leo Park @Samir Patel — if per-tenant cache reduces token counts that's a big win. but it touches runtime + storage + infra. do we have an estimate?

Samir Patel: rough calc: per-tenant KV adds ~2wk infra + 1wk runtime changes to integrate fast-path prefix caching (plus ops runway). depends on whether we shunt to existing redis cluster or need a new store. cost delta looks like ~10-15% infra for Dedicated.

Olivia Torres: Acme is flagged as "expansion likely" by CS. they said if this isn't addressed before GA they will pause rollout and re-evaluate. they are 2 largest in trial cohort.

Aaron Cole: if Acme pauses we could lose a ~$200k ACV ARR expansion. Sales is requesting we treat this as high priority for GA decisions.

Leo Park: two options: A) keep current MVP scope, ship GA on date, accept Acme risk; B) shift cutlist to include per-tenant cache in MVP and push GA by 1 sprint. we also have C) a hybrid: implement cache for Dedicated customers only for GA, host later.

Rachel G: hybrid sounds pragmatic: Dedicated customers (and pilot tenants) get cache early; Hosted users get caching later. But that increases product complexity and testing surface.

Samir Patel: hybrid is feasible if we gate config behind a feature flag and only enable for Dedicated clusters. ops work is limited compared to full host rollout. still need QA and e2e.

Maya Chen: proposal: move "metrics dashboard v0" and a11y polish -> v1, add per-tenant cache to MVP but gated to Dedicated for GA, keep tenant SSO in v1. push GA by one sprint (2 weeks).

Leo Park: is +2w acceptable to PM/Eng?

Rachel G: +2w is okay if we keep scope tight. need updated milestone and clear cutlist. also add a rollback plan if cache causes regressions.

Samir Patel: adding rollback: feature flag + runtime kill switch. add basic telemetry: cache hit rate, latency p50/p95, error rate.

Olivia Torres: I'll tell Acme we have a concrete plan and timeline. they asked for a firm commitment; we can offer a pilot in Dedicated in 3 weeks.

Aaron Cole: Sales accepts the compromise. they'll adjust contract language to include dedicated pilot terms.

Maya Chen: ok action items: 1) Samir/Leo — scope infra + runtime work and add checklist (due EOD Fri) 2) Rachel — update milestone doc & cutlist (due Mon) 3) Olivia/Aaron — align Acme communication and pilot offer (due Tue) 4) Maya — update launch plan and stakeholder email.

Leo Park: noted — I'll pair with Samir on infra estimate and start a doc: `https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-xxxxx` (placeholder).

Samir Patel: quick config sketch for the cache so folks know what we're talking about:
```
cache:
  per_tenant: true
  backend: redis
  ttl: 24h
  mode: feature_flag
```

Rachel G: also adding a quality gate — must show <10% token reduction regressions on our eval set and p95 latency under 400ms on pilot tenants before full GA.

cs_bot: Reminder: "Customer outreach scheduled" — Acme pilot notification scheduled for 2026-04-06.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone — pushing this as a formal scope rebalance. I'll set up a 30m sync tomorrow to go through the checklist. :thumbsup:

Aaron Cole: +1. if we need more runway we should surface to execs quickly.

Leo Park: ack. I'll add owners to each Jira and link in the milestone doc.

Rachel G: closing loop here — I'll update the public roadmap slice to reflect the v1 deferrals and the +1 sprint GA shift.

Maya Chen: last note — keep the messaging consistent: we rebalance to protect GA quality and a target interactivity SLA. thanks all."
